seoTitle: SKU Code Generator From Product Attributes
metaDescription: Build consistent SKU codes from category, colour, size and more with fixed segment length and an optional running number. Free, private.
intro: Turns a list of product attributes into consistent stock keeping unit codes.
why:
A good SKU is short, readable and the same every time. Building it from attributes means two people produce the same code for the same product, and a code can be read without a lookup.

The tool strips accents and symbols, keeps the first letters of each word segment, leaves numeric sizes whole, and can append a running number. It warns when two products get the same code so you can lengthen the segments.
howTo: Write one product per line with attributes separated by commas.
Set the prefix, separator and segment length.
Add a running number if you need a unique code per item.

faq.a: Short segments can collide, for example two colours starting with the same letters. Use more letters or a running number.
The tool removes them, since many systems break on spaces.

faq.q: Is a SKU the same as a barcode?
faq.a: No. A SKU is your own code; a GTIN or EAN is a global product number.
